questions: What constitutes a “valid even number” – may it be zero or negative, or must it be a positive even integer?
Must the four even numbers be distinct from each other, or can the same even number be used multiple times?
Are there any limits on the size of the even numbers (e.g., must they fit within typical integer ranges) or on n itself?
Should the function return a Boolean value, an integer (e.g., 1/0), or raise an exception for invalid inputs?
How should the function handle non‑integer inputs such as floats, strings, or None – should it coerce, reject, or treat them as invalid?
If n is itself even, does that affect the evaluation, or is the property independent of n’s parity?
Is the order of the four even numbers irrelevant (i.e., any permutation counts as the same representation), or must a specific ordering be considered?
Should the function consider only the existence of at least one representation, or must it verify that exactly one unique representation exists?
